invariants: No material scope change may be built before an approved Change Request exists
Change Request cannot silently alter the original quotation or invoice
Cost and time impact must be shown before customer approval
Customer approval must be explicit and evidence-backed
Internal bug fixes, agreed-scope defects and remediation are not automatically billable scope changes
Unknown impact or missing evidence returns HOLD or REVIEW
Rejected or superseded Change Requests must not alter active scope
Applied Change Requests create a new scope version and preserve prior scope history
Commercial or Production consequences remain human-gated
